title: Do Vision-Language Models Know Their Own Visual Weaknesses? Probing Capability-Level Metacognition
abstract: arXiv:2611.32940v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Metacognition includes knowing one's own strengths and weaknesses across kinds of tasks, not only judging whether a single answer is correct. We test whether vision-language models (VLMs) know in advance which kinds of visual tasks and image conditions are hard for them, across a wide range of open and proprietary models. Because some tasks are hard for every model, we separate what a model knows about this shared difficulty from what it knows about itself. We find that VLMs know little in advance about their visual weaknesses. They misjudge their overall accuracy and do not even know which kinds of tasks are hard for every model, and most misjudge how degraded images affect them. We further train VLMs to predict their own accuracy, which teaches them their own level of accuracy on kinds unseen in training but not which kinds are hard for them. translated_title: 视觉语言模型知道自己的视觉弱点吗？探测能力层面的元认知
translated_abstract: 元认知包括了解自己在各类任务中的优势与劣势，而不仅仅是判断单个答案是否正确。我们测试了视觉语言模型（VLM）能否提前知道哪些类型的视觉任务和图像条件对它们来说很困难，涵盖了大量开源与专有模型。由于某些任务对所有模型都很困难，我们将模型对这种共同困难的认识与它对自身困难的认识区分开来。我们发现，VLM对自身的视觉弱点几乎没有预先认知：它们会误判自己的整体准确率，甚至不知道哪些任务类型对所有模型都很困难，而且大多数模型会误判图像退化对自身的影响。我们进一步训练VLM预测自己的准确率，这使它们能够在训练中未见过的任务类型上了解自身的准确率水平，但并不能让它们知道哪些类型对自己来说很困难。然而，一旦模型开始解题，关于这些弱点的信息就会出现。
tldr: 视觉语言模型缺乏对自身视觉弱点的预先认知（能力层面元认知不足），训练其预测自身准确率可泛化到未见任务类型，但弱点信息只有在开始解题后才显现。
en_tdlr: Vision-language models lack advance metacognitive awareness of their own visual weaknesses; training them to predict their accuracy generalizes to unseen task types, but weakness information only emerges once the model begins solving.
